title: PostgreSQL HA - PostgreSQL
description: Throughput, connections, cache, checkpoints, WAL, locks, sizes and top queries per node.

targets.expr: sum by (pg_node) (pg_stat_activity_count{pg_node=~"$node"}) / on(pg_node) group_left() max by (pg_node) (pg_settings_max_connections{pg_node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared_buffers.

targets.expr: sum by (pg_node) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{pg_node=~"$node", datname=~"$datname"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (pg_node) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{pg_node=~"$node", datname=~"$datname"}[5m]) + rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{pg_node=~"$node", datname=~"$datname"}[5m])), 1)

panels.title: Active time
panels.description: Seconds spent executing statements per second (roughly: busy backends).

panels.title: Longest transaction
panels.description: Long transactions block vacuum and replication cleanup.

panels.title: Blocks read from disk vs cache
Temporary files written
panels.description: Sorts and hashes that didn't fit in work_mem.

panels.title: Checkpoints
panels.description: Requested checkpoints mean max_wal_size is filling up before checkpoint_timeout.

panels.title: Replica query conflicts
panels.description: Queries on replicas cancelled because replay needed the rows.

panels.title: Top 15 by total time
panels.description: Seconds of execution per second, over the last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (pg_node, datname, user, queryid) (rate(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{pg_node=~"$node"}[5m])) * on(queryid) group_left(query) max by (queryid, query) (pg_stat_statements_query_id))
topk(15, sum by (pg_node, datname, user, queryid) (rate(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{pg_node=~"$node"}[5m])) * on(queryid) group_left(query) max by (queryid, query) (pg_stat_statements_query_id))
